messages: Ethan: Quick usability bug during compare testing — screen reader doesn’t announce when a row is pinned, so blind users can’t tell which model/version is active for compare. Ethan: Also noticed that when you apply a fuzzy filter then pin a version, switching tabs to another view clears the filter silently. Priya: Ugh, that’s bad. For the pin state we should use `aria-pressed` on the pin control and a visible pinned label in the row. Priya: Example: `button[aria-pressed=true]` + a subtle label `span.sr-only` that reads "Pinned for compare". Zoe: Microcopy: current tooltip says "Pin" — can we change to "Pin to compare"? helps set expectation that it won't affect the model catalog globally. Zoe: Also propose adding a persistent small banner over the compare table when any rows are pinned: "Showing 2 pinned models for compare" with a clear "Clear pins" action. Ethan: The banner will help orientation. For keyboard users, ensure the banner receives focus when it appears or is reachable via Tab order. a11y-bot: Recommended checklist: 1) Pin button must have `aria-pressed` and an accessible name that includes state. 2) Visible text label (not just color/icon). 3) Announce banner with `role=status` or `aria-live=polite` when pins change. 4) Preserve filter state across view tabs or warn users before clearing. Priya: For the filter persistence: maybe store session state keyed by route so switching tabs restores filters. This avoids surprising clears. Zoe: UX edge: when many rows are pinned (>3) the banner could get noisy. Suggest collapsed pill: "2 pinned" that expands to list on click. Ethan: Good call. Also found a minor contrast issue: the pinned chip uses white text on brand-yellow at 12px; fails contrast at small sizes. We should check ratio >= 4.5:1. Zoe: Will update the Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/model-catalog-compare-pins (WIP) Priya: Implementation snippet for the button we can drop into the component lib: ``` ``` Ethan: Nice. Dev note: ensure tests for keyboard + screen reader in Cypress (a11y snapshot) and unit test for `aria-pressed` state. DevDeploy-bot: Reminder: upcoming dependent change to compare API will alter response shape — coordinate with eng-runtime before shipping. Zoe: OK will sync with runtime owners. Priya: Next steps: Zoe to update Figma + banner designs; Ethan to add aria-live banner implementation; Ill add filter session proposal to the RFC. Ethan: Planning a small PR for pin button + banner, aiming for end-of-week. Zoe: :thumbsup: Ethan: Any other concerns?
